subject: [PATCH v5 7/7] mm: use VMA flag helpers in NUMA balancing

reviews.author: Lorenzo Stoakes (ARM)
reviews.summary: Identified that the 'Acked-by' tag was no longer required and suggested removing it. Also mentioned a potential conflict with his own VMA flags series, but stated that resolutions should be trivial.

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: Acknowledged Lorenzo's comment and stated that he had cargo-culted the 'Acked-by' tag from prior revisions, suggesting it could be dropped.

2026-11-10.patch_summary: This patch series introduces VMA flag helpers to the NUMA balancing code, replacing direct accesses to vm_flags. The change is intended to be functional and does not alter existing behavior.
